Description: Troy is the Pike County seat in southeast Alabama and home to Troy University, as well as Lockheed Martin's major Missiles and Fire Control manufacturing facility producing THAAD and Javelin missile systems. It features very low housing costs, humid-subtropical weather, a vibrant college-town atmosphere, and local Walmart retail access. Nearest outpatient VA care is located 36 miles away at the Wiregrass VA Clinic.
